conflicts.issue: The July 9 launch reports call this the first or initial iOS 9 public appearance but do not consistently display the literal label “Public Beta 1.”
conflicts.resolution: Normalize the first appearance to Public Beta 1 because two independent launch reports establish the appearance and the July 22 reports explicitly identify the next seed as Public Beta 2.
conflicts.productionConstraint: Preserve ordinalBasis=normalizedFirstAppearance and the qualification; do not claim Apple used this exact display label on July 9.

conflicts.issue: CHIP published the following morning, and the iDevice.ro canonical URL ends in ios-10-public-beta-5 despite its headline and article body repeatedly saying Public Beta 4.
conflicts.resolution: Use August 9 based on the same-day iDevice.ro article metadata and MacRumors public-tester update; CHIP independently identifies the fourth public beta and says it had been available since Tuesday evening.
conflicts.productionConstraint: Cite content and publication metadata, not the misleading iDevice.ro URL slug, when explaining the ordinal.
